items.caption: This oracle-script style redraw places two distinct forms vertically: an upper form with two enclosed spaces above a lower angular form with a long descending stroke. It illustrates one reported early layout of 好.
items.alt: Black redraw with a complex upper form containing two enclosed spaces above a smaller angular lower form with a long down-right stroke.
items.selection_reason: Its vertical arrangement contrasts with the side-by-side bronze-style redraw and helps show reported variation in the placement of 好’s analyzed components.
items.period: Shang oracle-script style; modern redraw, not a dated artifact specimen

items.caption: This bronze-script style redraw places two distinct forms side by side: a tall, branched form on the left and a rounded, open form with a descending tail on the right. It shows a different reported layout of 好.
items.alt: Black redraw with a tall branched form at left and a rounded open form with a long descending tail at right.
items.selection_reason: Its side-by-side arrangement contrasts with the vertical oracle-style redraw and helps illustrate reported variation in component placement.
items.period: Bronze-script style; no specific specimen date established

limitations.text: These modern redraws show forms labeled by script tradition, not dated inscription specimens. Their shapes alone do not establish component identity or 好’s original motivation; proposals for that motivation remain disputed.
